label: Access
definition: Sustained access by a criminal actor or interest to a legal-economy entity market resource or decision channel

label: Participation
definition: Sustained participation in a legal-economy entity market or transaction system

label: Influence
definition: Capacity to shape decisions behaviour allocation or market outcomes without requiring formal control

label: Control
definition: De facto or de jure capacity to direct a legal-economy entity activity or decision process

label: Ownership
definition: Direct indirect or beneficial ownership used as the legal or economic basis for sustained criminal participation or control

label: Embeddedness
definition: Durable integration into legal economic relationships networks institutions or governance structures
